remarks: Welcome to a truly rare rental opportunity in one of South Norwalk's most sought-after neighborhoods. This beautifully renovated two-story apartment, occupying the 2nd and 3rd floors of a well-maintained multifamily home, offers the perfect blend of modern convenience and classic charm. With three generously sized bedrooms and two full bathrooms, the space is ideal for those seeking comfort, functionality, and a touch of elegance. The apartment has been thoughtfully updated with new flooring, fresh paint, and a stylish modern kitchen designed to elevate everyday living. Natural light fills each room, highlighting the craftsmanship and attention to detail throughout. The private entryway offers a sense of independence and privacy, while the spacious layout ensures room to live, work, and relax. Additional amenities include one off-street parking space in the driveway, on-site laundry, and a fully fenced-in yard-perfect for enjoying outdoor time. Heat and water are included in the rent, adding even more value to this already compelling home. Location-wise, it doesn't get better. You're just 0.8 miles from the Metro North train station and only a mile from Veterans Park and Norwalk Marina. The vibrant energy of downtown SoNo, with its eclectic restaurants, boutique shops, and waterfront views, is just a few blocks away. This apartment offers more than just a place to live-it's a lifestyle. Stylish, spacious, and situated in an unbeatable location!
